readme:
# Octo 双重padding掩码归约

## 1. 问题

Octo 双重padding掩码归约：实现下列接口并通过数值、边界和实验检查。

提取官方动作头的masked_mean及时间/动作padding交集；计算未乘额外action_dim系数的逐坐标平方误差，不实现扩散网络。

## 2. 核心公式

$$
M_{bwhd}=T_{bw}\land A_{bwhd},\qquad L=\frac{\operatorname{mean}(M\odot(\hat a-a)^2)}{\max(\operatorname{mean}(M),10^{-5})}.
$$

## 3. 公式到代码

- `masked_action_loss(prediction: Tensor, target: Tensor, timestep_valid: Tensor, action_valid: Tensor) -> Tensor`

观察窗口中的padding与动作时域/维度padding含义不同，必须取交集。有效元素占比进入分母，因此追加padding不稀释损失；极端稀疏掩码遵循源码分母下界。

## 4. 本题约定

预测与目标为(B,W,H,D)，timestep_valid为(B,W)布尔，action_valid为(B,W,H,D)布尔。目标detach；全padding返回可反传的0；保留源码1e-5分母下界。

校验辅助函数已提供。浮点输入为有限 CPU float32/float64，不修改输入；非法形状、类型、范围或掩码必须抛出 `ValueError`。

## 5. 交互图与确定性实验

`experiment.py` 在固定输入上调用提交的全部接口，记录学习或采样曲线与末端指标。实验逻辑和阈值见 T3，输出同样用于可视化。

可视化由 `viz/gen.py` 生成；T3 将你的函数传入同一实验并记录真实指标。这是小规模确定性教学实验，不是机器人基准成绩。

## 6. 在网页中运行

在右侧 Python 编辑器中补全实现，点击 **运行测试**。查看失败测试的原因、期望值与实际值，修改代码后再次运行。所有必要测试通过后，题目会标记为已完成并解锁坑点讲解。

## 7. 来源与延伸

- [Octo: An Open-Source Generalist Robot Policy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.12213) — Official action_heads.py masked_mean and timestep/action pad-mask intersection
- [Verified source](https://github.com/octo-models/octo/blob/main/octo/model/components/action_heads.py)

核验日期：2026-10-28。扩展到完整论文系统还需要本题范围中明确省略的模型、数据和环境。

# Octo: 题解与易错点

观察窗口中的padding与动作时域/维度padding含义不同，必须取交集。有效元素占比进入分母，因此追加padding不稀释损失；极端稀疏掩码遵循源码分母下界。

先按公式确定归约轴、有效掩码和梯度路径，再将手算小例与实现逐项比较。测试中的独立预期值不调用参考答案。

## 测试捕获的错误

- Observation-window padding is ignored.
- Padding dilutes the loss because the valid fraction is omitted.

## 实验范围

提取官方动作头的masked_mean及时间/动作padding交集；计算未乘额外action_dim系数的逐坐标平方误差，不实现扩散网络。

## 可重复实验记录

1×2×2×2动作张量，仅2个坐标有效，其余目标设100；40步梯度下降(lr=0.2)。要求loss<初始1e-6，被padding坐标不移动。

判题固定seed=42。计算采用CPU float64、显式输入，涉及优化时使用普通梯度更新；不下载数据集或模型权重。原生PyTorch与真实Pyodide/NumPy-WASM执行同一套T0–T3测试。阈值针对本教学实验。

en.title: Octo Dual Padding-Mask Reduction
en.readme:
# Octo Dual Padding-Mask Reduction

## 1. Exercise goal

Octo Dual Padding-Mask Reduction: implement the interfaces below and verify numerical, boundary and experimental behavior.

Isolate the action head masked_mean and intersection of timestep/action padding. Compute coordinatewise squared error before any head-specific action_dim scaling; omit the diffusion network.

## 2. Core equations

$$
M_{bwhd}=T_{bw}\land A_{bwhd},\qquad L=\frac{\operatorname{mean}(M\odot(\hat a-a)^2)}{\max(\operatorname{mean}(M),10^{-5})}.
$$

## 3. From equations to code

- `masked_action_loss(prediction: Tensor, target: Tensor, timestep_valid: Tensor, action_valid: Tensor) -> Tensor`

Observation-window padding and action-horizon/dimension padding are distinct and must intersect. Divide by the valid fraction so adding padding does not dilute the loss; extremely sparse masks follow the source denominator floor.

## 4. Contract and boundaries

Prediction/target are (B,W,H,D), timestep_valid bool (B,W), action_valid bool (B,W,H,D). Detach targets. All-padding returns differentiable zero. Retain the source denominator floor 1e-5.

Validation helpers are provided. All floating inputs are finite CPU float32/float64; do not mutate inputs. Invalid shape, dtype, range or mask arguments raise `ValueError`.

## 5. Deterministic experiment and visualization

`experiment.py` calls every submitted interface on fixed inputs and records a learning or sampling curve and terminal metrics. T3 states the behavioral thresholds; the visualization uses the same outputs.

The visualization is generated by `viz/gen.py`; T3 runs the same experiment with your functions and records its actual metrics. These are small deterministic teaching results, not a robot benchmark.

## 6. Run your implementation

Complete the functions in the Python editor on the right, then click **Run tests**. Inspect each failed check, update your implementation, and run again. Passing every required check marks the problem as solved and unlocks the notes.

## 7. Sources and extensions

- [Octo: An Open-Source Generalist Robot Policy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.12213) — Official action_heads.py masked_mean and timestep/action pad-mask intersection
- [Verified source](https://github.com/octo-models/octo/blob/main/octo/model/components/action_heads.py)

Verified 2026-10-28. Extending this operator to the full paper requires the omitted model, data and environment described in the scope above.

# Octo: Solution notes

Observation-window padding and action-horizon/dimension padding are distinct and must intersect. Divide by the valid fraction so adding padding does not dilute the loss; extremely sparse masks follow the source denominator floor.

Identify reduction axes, validity masks and gradient paths from the equations before comparing a small hand calculation. Test oracles do not call the reference implementation.

## Mistakes caught by the tests

- Observation-window padding is ignored.
- Padding dilutes the loss because the valid fraction is omitted.

## Experimental scope

Isolate the action head masked_mean and intersection of timestep/action padding. Compute coordinatewise squared error before any head-specific action_dim scaling; omit the diffusion network.

## Reproducible protocol

A 1×2×2×2 action tensor with two valid coordinates and padded targets set to 100; 40 gradient steps at lr .2. Require loss below 1e-6 of initial and no movement in padded coordinates.

The judge fixes seed 42. All calculations use CPU float64, explicit inputs and plain gradient updates where applicable; no datasets or model weights are downloaded. Native PyTorch and actual Pyodide/NumPy-WASM run the same T0–T3 suite. Thresholds refer to this teaching adaptation.
